product.schneider-n38616-40.summary: The N386/16 with a 40 MB disk.
product.schneider-n38616-40.history: The German offer of December 1991 listed the 40 MB N386/16 notebook at DM 5,156 net and included MS-DOS 5.0 and G-BASIC.
product.schneider-n38616-40.technical.co: The sales list specifies 1 MB of RAM. An owner documented 2 MB in his 40 MB unit and photographed the N386/16 user manual.
product.schneider-n38616-40.technical.ve: The commercial offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
product.schneider-n38616-40.technical.li: The board still needs identification and an attributed BIOS needs preservation. An image with clear publication rights remains pending.
product.schneider-n38616-40.technical.pr: CC SELLER / BC, Schneider Computer, 12/1991, pp. 1–2
